question.problem:
$$
T=[\begin{aligned}-3 & 1 \\ -2 & -8 \\ -9 & 7\end{aligned}],\,T:[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]⟶[\begin{aligned}-3x+y \\ ax-8y \\ -9x+by\end{aligned}]
$$

Consider the standard matrix $T$ of the linear transformation $T:{R}^{2}\to {R}^{3}$ shown above. What is the value of $a+b?$
question.worked_solution:
Given the vector $\,[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]\,$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}-3 & 1 \\ -2 & -8 \\ -9 & 7\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-3x+y \\ -2x-8y \\ -9x+7y\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the linear transformation $T$ is given by

$$
T:[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]⟶[\begin{aligned}-3x+y \\ -2x-8y \\ -9x+7y\end{aligned}].
$$

Finally, $a+b=-2+7=5.$
